claims.text: whether NodeClock::now() influencing the parameters causes an anonymity break

claims.status_by_quote: Rewritten to take that approach. The commit history is simpler now too

claims.text: the floating-point bisection loop can infinite-loop due to x87 excess precision

claims.status_note: author switched to integer bisection over bufsize

claims.text: track only fail_buf while growing the search range and derive succ_buf at the end
